_about: Hand corrections applied on top of world-countries 5.1.0 currencies and Natural Earth ECONOMY. Each record replaces the derived one in full.

notes.BGR: Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026; world-countries 5.1.0 lists the lev (BGN).
notes.CUB: The convertible peso (CUC) was withdrawn in 2021; world-countries lists CUC and CUP.
notes.ESH: Western Sahara: world-countries lists DZD, MAD and MRU; the atlas keeps MAD and DZD only.
notes.UNK: Kosovo: currency unchanged; the Natural Earth economy class is left empty in the live data (the reason was not recorded).
notes.SLE: Sierra Leone redenominated the leone in 2022 (new code SLE); world-countries lists the old code SLL.
notes.ZWE: Zimbabwe introduced Zimbabwe Gold (ZiG) in April 2024; the US dollar is also in use. world-countries lists nine currencies, including bond notes (ZWB), and not ZiG.
